### what_to_do_first.details[2]

flags.sentence: HILMO diagnosis concordance is about 90% in a 2019 journal article, but public report data lack age and stage adjustments (about 48% missing stage) and pathway wait timestamps.
flags.problem: The claim that public report data lack age adjustments is not supported by any of the cited claims (which cover diagnosis concordance, stage missingness, referral, and treatment start only), and overreaches since Kuva 16 of the public report does include age-adjusted curative treatment figures by sex (though not county values for Pohjois-Pohjanmaa).
